Frontend UI verification confirms subscription features are working: Abonnements tab shows subscription counters, Robert Martin's Care subscription card with delete button, Nouvel abonnement and Sync Shopify buttons visible, Stats page shows Abon. Standard and Abon. Care counts.

Stats page correctly shows subscription counts (subscriptions_standard, subscriptions_care)
Phone number normalization works correctly for French numbers
